summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandfather; a pecoraio (shepherd) of Bisaccia, father of Frank Giannetta.
bio: FS tree: Savino Giannetta, b. 1842 (Round 2 tree additions give 12 Jan 1842). Marriage, Bisaccia, 20 Jul 1867, Matrimoni 1867 act 17: Savino, 24 (born c.1843), pecoraio (shepherd), son of the late Francesco Giannetta and Lucia Macchia(?); bride Angelamaria Fede, 18. He was still living at his son Frank's marriage on 1 Aug 1896. The Giannettas and Fedes were shepherds, typical of upland grazing Bisaccia.
